story.title: Undone by a honey trap? Nvidia's Jensen Huang at heart of China spy scandal
story.summary: Turns out that the new masters of the universe are human, all too human. China accused of exploiting a vulnerability at the heart of the Silicon Valley giant that reigns supreme over two-thirds of the planet’s AI computing power production, the Nvidia co-founder tempted by the flesh. Jensen Huang admitting to an extramarital affair with Singapore-based Chinese tech CEO Alice Huang - no relation. She’s under scrutiny over the purchase of Nvidia state-of-the-art chips that may have been smuggled back to the mainland illegally. We’ll ask about the rise and possible fall of the Taiwan-born leather

linkedin.title: We decided to stop optimizing for how long you spend on our app.
linkedin.body:
Most news apps are built like slot machines. They want you to scroll forever so they can serve more ads. We took a different approach when building the feed for Headlinne.

We intentionally capped the number of articles we show you each day. Instead of trying to keep you glued to your screen, our goal is to give you the most relevant update possible and then let you get back to your day.

It sounds counterintuitive for a tech company. But we believe the value of a news app isn't in how much time you waste. It is in how much time you save while staying informed.

We use AI to filter out the noise and surface only what matters to you personally. Once you have read your daily briefing, the feed stops. No infinite scroll. No junk. Just the news you actually need.

slides.subtitle: China reportedly used a honey trap against the founder

slides.explanation: Nvidia controls two-thirds of the world's AI computing power. That is effectively a monopoly on the hardware driving the modern AI boom.

slides.headline: The vulnerability was personal, not technical
slides.explanation: While we usually expect tech giants to be targeted by cyberattacks or corporate espionage, this breach allegedly exploited human nature directly through a honey trap.
Nine major outlets including the BBC and The Verge have verified these reports. When this many independent newsrooms agree, the details are highly reliable.

slides.subtitle: Read the full breakdown on Headlinne.

instagram.caption:
It is rare to see a tech giant like Nvidia face a scandal of this nature.

Usually, these stories are about code, servers, or stock prices.

This report suggests that even the most powerful companies are vulnerable to old-school espionage tactics. It serves as a reminder that the people behind the technology are often the easiest point of entry.

Have you ever considered how human error impacts global tech security?

story_card.headline: Democrat Scott Colom wins Mississippi Senate seat
story_card.standfirst: A historic upset ends decades of Republican control in the state's Senate race.

steps.label: What happened
steps.text: Democrat Scott Colom defeated Republican incumbent Cindy Hyde-Smith by a very narrow margin.

steps.label: How we got here
steps.text: The result followed over a week of vote counting in a state that last elected a Democrat in 1982.

steps.label: Why it matters
steps.text: Colom is the first Black senator elected in Mississippi since the Reconstruction era.

steps.label: What to watch
steps.text: Observers will watch for how this shift impacts the balance of power in the Senate.

story_card.caption:
Scott Colom has defeated incumbent Cindy Hyde-Smith in a historic Mississippi Senate election result.

This victory marks the first time Mississippi has sent a Democrat to the Senate in over forty years. It also represents a major milestone as Colom becomes the state's first Black senator elected since the Reconstruction period. The outcome was only confirmed after a week of intense vote counting.
